
### library-crossing CFGs {.smaller}

::::: {.columns}

:::: {.column}

```c
#include <png.h>
void ReadImageFromNetwork(
    png_structp libpng_handle,
    unsigned char *bytes,
    size_t size
) { ...  }

int main() {
    /* init libpng */
    png_structp libpng_handle = ...;
    /* tell libpng how to read image data */
    png_set_read_fn(
        libpng_handle, ...,
        ReadImageFromNetwork
    )
    ...
    /* extract "header" 
       information from image */
    png_get_IHDR(libpng_handle, ...)
    ...
}
```

::::

:::: {.column}


![](/cfi/texfig/tracking.figure.svg){width=400px fig-alt="control flow graph, showing flow from main to png_set_read_fn, then back to main, then to png_get_IHDR, then to ReadImageFromNetwork. All of these control flow transfers are shown to cross the boundary between executable and library."}

### CFGs will be imprecise  {.smaller}


```c
FunctionPtr p = functionA;
Example() {
  while (true) {
    ...
    if (SomethingComplicated()) {
      (*p)();
    } else if (SomethngElseComplicated()) {
      foo();
    }
    ...
  }
}
foo() {
  ...
  if (AnotherComplexThing()) {
    p = functionB;
  }
}
```
 

* can Example() call functionB()? probably not practical to tell 
   * need to make conservative ‘yes’ guess
